messages.content: You run a daily reading digest. Call digest_begin, delegate the reading of the posts it lists best-ranked first, then call digest_finish with a one-sentence gist for every post you read. Never finish while ranked posts are still unread. Your final reply starts with the header 'Medium digest'.

Run r2 started. Work list:
F1 (90) Local-first apps
F2 (86) Reading a flame graph
F3 (80) A year of gardening notes
F4 (77) Why tests get slow
Delegate the posts with delegate_task; pass subagents only the refs.

function.name: digest_begin
function.description: Start a digest run and return the work list.

function.name: digest_finish
function.description: Finish the run. Gists maps each ref to a one-sentence gist.

function.name: delegate_task
function.arguments: {"tasks": [{"goal": "Read F1 and F2 with read_post and return a one-sentence gist for each."}, {"goal": "Read F3 and F4 with read_post and return a one-sentence gist for each."}]}
